def transform3(g):
    from collections import Counter
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cellsby={}
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: cellsby.setdefault(g[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dirs={'main':(1,1),'anti':(1,-1),'vert':(1,0),'horiz':(0,1)}
    def linekey(a,b):
        dr,dc=a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1]
        if dr==0: return 'horiz'
        if dc==0: return 'vert'
        if dr==dc: return 'main'
        if dr==-dc: return 'anti'
        return None
    for color,cls in cellsby.items():
        s=set(cls)
        # group into maximal lines per orientation
        for orient,(dr,dc) in dirs.items():
            key=(lambda r,c: c) if orient=='vert' else (lambda r,c: r) if orient=='horiz' else (lambda r,c: r-c) if orient=='main' else (lambda r,c: r+c)
            groups={}
            for (r,c) in cls: groups.setdefault(key(r,c),[]).append((r,c))
            for k,cells in groups.items():
                if len(cells)<2: continue
                cells.sort()
                for end,step in ((cells[0],(-dr,-dc)),(cells[-1],(dr,dc))):
                    r,c=end
                    # attachment check: orthogonally adjacent foreign (non-bg, other color)
                    blocked=False
                    for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                        if 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and g[nr][nc]!=bg and g[nr][nc]!=color:
                            blocked=True;break
                    if blocked: continue
                    nr,nc=r+step[0],c+step[1]
                    while 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and g[nr][nc]==bg:
                        out[nr][nc]=color
                        nr+=step[0];nc+=step[1]
    return out

def transformV(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for color in set(x for row in g for x in row)-{bg,0}:
        cells={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==color}
        dirs=[(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]
        for dr,dc in dirs:
            seen=set()
            for (r,c) in sorted(cells):
                if (r,c) in seen or (r-dr,c-dc) in cells: continue
                run=[]; rr,cc=r,c
                while (rr,cc) in cells: run.append((rr,cc)); seen.add((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                if len(run)<2: continue
                for end,direction in [(run[0],(-dr,-dc)),(run[-1],(dr,dc))]:
                    r0,c0=end
                    if r0==0 or r0==R-1 or c0==0 or c0==C-1: continue
                    # end locked if orth-adjacent to a foreign real color (bg and 0 don't block)
                    if any(0<=r0+a<R and 0<=c0+b<C and g[r0+a][c0+b] not in (bg,color,0)
                           for a,b in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]): continue
                    rr,cc=r0+direction[0],c0+direction[1]
                    while 0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C and g[rr][cc]==bg:
                        out[rr][cc]=color; rr+=direction[0]; cc+=direction[1]
    return out
